data.name: Kanzul
data.gender_notes: Kanzul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A treasure trove of good deeds, a storehouse of virtues. The name Kanzul carries the meaning “Treasury of Good Deeds” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kanzul usually hope their child will grow to embody treasury of good deeds and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Kanzul refers to the treasure of good deeds that one accumulates in this life, which will be rewarded in the afterlife.
data.etymology: Kanzul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Treasury of Good Deeds.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kanzul total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: كنزول
in_arabic.meaning: معنی: ذخیره گنجینة ثروت و ثمرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: تفسیر: کنز از لغت کنز است که به معنای گنجینة ثروت و ثمرة است. کنزول از ترکیب کلمه کنز و صفت الزا (سازگار با، خوشبختی بار) تشکیل شده است. کنزول به معنای گنجینة خوشبختی و ثروت است. در اسلام، کنز به معنای گنجینة معرفت و علم نیز است. کنزول به یکی از نام های خوشبختی، ثروت و علم در اسلام است.

in_urdu.name: کنزول
in_urdu.meaning: معنی: ذخیرہ گنجینہ دولت اور دولت
in_urdu.long_meaning: تفسیر: کنز ہندورویکے لفظ کنز ہے جس کا مطلب ہے گنجینہ دولت اور دولت۔ کنزول کا مطلب ہے گنجینہ دولت اور دولت جس کی صفت الزا (سازگار با، خوشبختی بار) ہے۔ کنزول کا مطلب ہے گنجینہ دولت اور دولت۔ در اسلام، کنز کو گنجینہ علم کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔ کنزول ایک نام ہے جس کی صفت خوشبختی، دولت اور علم ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: कन्ज़ुल
in_hindi.meaning: अर्थ: धन और समृद्धि का भंडार
in_hindi.long_meaning: व्याख्या: कन्ज़ुल शब्द अरबी के शब्द कन्ज़ से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है धन और समृद्धि का भंडार। कन्ज़ुल का अर्थ है धन और समृद्धि का भंडार जो खुशियों और धन के साथ भरा हुआ है। इस्लाम में, कन्ज़ुल को ज्ञान और समझ का भंडार माना जाता है। कन्ज़ुल एक ऐसा नाम है जो खुशियों, धन और ज्ञान के गुणों को दर्शाता है।

in_english.name: Kanzul
in_english.meaning: Meaning: Treasure of wealth and prosperity, symbol of knowledge and spiritual growth
in_english.long_meaning: Etymology: Kanzul is derived from the Arabic root K-N-Z, meaning treasure or wealth. The addition of the suffix Zul, meaning good or happy, adds a sense of prosperity and happiness to the name. In Islamic tradition, Kanzul represents the treasure of knowledge and spiritual growth, signifying a life of wisdom, prosperity, and happiness. The name Kanzul is used in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the pursuit of knowledge, wealth, and spiritual enlightenment.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kanzul" has ancient roots in the Arabic language and translates to "a treasure trove" or "a storehouse" in English. The name has a profound cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it is reminiscent of the infinite blessings and rewards that Muslims can amass through their good deeds in life. The name is often given to children as a reminder of the importance of storing up good deeds for the hereafter. It is also a common name for charitable institutions and organizations that strive to preserve, protect, and distribute the wealth of knowledge and resources for the benefit of the community.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic theory, the notion of "Kanzul" refers to the spiritual treasure that each individual accumulates through performing good deeds, reciting the Quran, seeking knowledge, and adhering to the teachings of Islam. The Quran states that the best form of wealth is that which is earned through good deeds and is exempt from decay (Al-Qasas: 15). This treasure is not material but spiritual in nature and will accompany the person in the Hereafter. The accumulation of this treasure is a central theme in Islamic spirituality, and the name "Kanzul" serves as a constant reminder of the importance of a virtuous life and the rewards that await us in the next world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Treasury of Good Deeds" symbolizes A treasure trove of good deeds, a storehouse of virtues.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kanzul serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of treasury of good deeds.
